title: IDD Provider Outage Declaration Marker Payload
description: Structured payload parsed from an idd-provider-outage-declaration comment on the configured providerOutage.declarationTarget issue.

actor.description: GitHub login of the declaring actor, as embedded in the marker (display only; the comment's actual GitHub author is the authority evidence).

service.description: Affected service the declaration covers, matched exactly (case-insensitive) against a caller's requested service.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp the declaration window opens. Together with expiresAt, bounded by the configured providerOutage.maxValidity.

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp the declaration window closes. Validity is recomputed live against this value on every read; no cleanup step is required on expiry.

createdAt.description: The GitHub-assigned created_at of the comment carrying this marker, or "none" when unavailable. Used only to pick the most recently authored declaration among several; never itself a validity input.
